description: mcx: auto-filter MCP tool results and impose an explicit /mcx:new routing gate once 2+ MCP calls land in one session, or on a bloated result (PostToolUse). New multi-call workflows run as heredoc-fed ad-hoc source; /mcx:save is reserved for explicit persistence requests. UserPromptSubmit routes literal mcx mentions to /mcx:mcx. All handlers are fail-open — a failure never breaks the tool call or prompt. Opt out with MCX_FILTER=off, MCX_OBSERVE=off, or MCX_NUDGE=off.
